text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I knew I wouldn't be able to beat you at
arm
wrestling. You're just too strong,
Kawakami!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It's only natural for a princess to have
this level of
strength! Now, who's my
next opponent?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, are you having an arm wrestling

tournament? Count me in!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh! Hnnngh! N-not bad at all,
Kawakami!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Y-you too, Pearl! Hnnngh! I didn't
expect you to
hold your own against me!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, stop, you two! The floor is
making a weird
noise! Things are gonna
end badly if you keep
going!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... I had no idea you were this strong... You must have one... incredible training routine...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... I just use what my trainer taught me about leveraging strength!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
For example, when I'm doing weight
training, I
focus on my form rather than
doing high reps!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha, and you can see the results for
yourself. My
trainer is the ultimate pearl
that brightens my
shine!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! Does that mean you're going to
grow
even stronger?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! The possibilities are limitless
when it
comes to my trainer and me!
We're always aiming
higher!
